message.content:
**Battle of Stalingrad (1942‑1943)** | Aspect | Details | |--------|---------| | **Main participants** | • **Soviet Union** – Red Army (commanded by General Fyodor Kharitonov, later General Georgy Zhukov)
• **Nazi Germany** – Wehrmacht’s 6th Army (initially under General Friedrich Löhmann, later General Fedor von Bock)
• **Axis allies** – Italian, Romanian, Hungarian, and German auxiliary units supported the German effort. | | **Location** | The city of **Stalingrad** (now **Volgograd**) in southern Russia, on the eastern bank of the **Volga River**. The battle encompassed the entire urban area, the surrounding industrial zone, and the adjacent countryside. | The confrontation became one of the deadliest and most decisive battles of World War II, turning the tide in favor of the Allies on the Eastern Front.
